🎣 Playing Hooky | Reel in Relaxation at This 4BR Retreat

Welcome to Playing Hooky—a gorgeous escape tucked into quiet Inlet Beach. With 4 bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms, and room for up to 14 guests, this two-story home is perfect for families or friends looking to relax in comfort while still staying close to the action. Located about a mile from the shops and restaurants of 30A, it’s an easy bike ride to the beach and nearby hotspots. Plus, with thoughtful extras like bikes, a fire pit, and an EV charger, everything you need is right here.

⸻

🌟 Why You’ll Love It Here
• Relaxed Outdoor Living – Unwind by the fire pit or fire up the grill for an evening with family and friends.
• EV Charger Included – A great perk for electric vehicle drivers.
• Fully Equipped Gourmet Kitchen – Complete with stainless appliances, gas range, and everything you need to cook and gather.
• Bikes Provided – Cruise down to the beach or 30A in minutes without the stress of parking.
• Spa-Inspired Bathrooms – Featuring a soaking tub, walk-in showers, and upscale finishes.
• Ultrafast WiFi + Smart TVs – Stream your favorites and stay connected.
• Washer & Dryer – Keep everything fresh throughout your stay.

🌴 Location Perks
• 1/2 Mile to the Beach , 1 Mile from 30A – A quick bike ride to Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach, and more.
• Near Dining + Shopping – Close to boutique shops, restaurants, and cafes.
• Quiet Neighborhood – Set back from the crowds, but close enough to enjoy it all.

⸻

📋 Playing Hooky at a Glance
• 4 Bedrooms | 3.5 Bathrooms | Sleeps 14
• Fire Pit + Grill
• EV Charger
• 4 Adult Cruiser Bikes
• Smart TVs + Ultrafast WiFi
• Washer & Dryer
• Central A/C
• Peaceful Cul-de-Sac Location
• 1 Mile to 30A + Beach Access

⸻

✈️ Nearby Airports
• Panama City Beach (ECP) – 21 mi | ~30 min
• Destin–Fort Walton (VPS) – 49 mi | ~1 hr 20 min
• Pensacola (PNS) – 110 mi | ~2 hrs

⸻

🎣 Book your stay at Playing Hooky and enjoy comfort, convenience, and coastal fun—just a short bike ride from everything 30A has to offer.

🤝 About Us
We are a local company specializing in transporting you from the stresses of daily life to carefree days at the beach. We have team members in the communities where we manage homes throughout the day. Please do not hesitate to contact us via phone, text, or your original booking channel with any questions you may have.

At 30A Sea Story, we`ll provide the setting, you provide the tale...

Spring Break Curfew Notice:
Please be advised that March 1 – April 19, a 7:00 PM curfew for unaccompanied minors under the age of 18 will be in effect in coordination with the Walton County Sheriff`s Office.
This policy applies to Seaside, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach, and the majority of communities along 30A, all of which are enforcing these Spring Break safety regulations in unison with local law enforcement.
Guests are responsible for ensuring all members of their party comply with community guidelines and local regulations.
PLEASE NOTE: WE DO NOT RENT TO STUDENT GROUPS, AGE OF PRIMARY RENTER MUST BE 25 OR OLDER AND RESIDING IN PROPERTY DURING STAY.
1. Smoking is NOT allowed. Evidence of smoking in the unit after guest departure will be subject to an additional cleaning fee charged to the guest who the reservation is under.

2. People other than those noted in the booking may not stay overnight in the property. Any other person in the property is the sole responsibility of Guest.

3. All our properties are privately owned; property management and the owners are not responsible for any accidents, injuries or illness that occurs while on the premises or its facilities. Property management and the homeowners are not responsible for the loss of personal belongings or valuables of the guest. By accepting this reservation, it is agreed that all guests are expressly assuming the risk of any harm arising from their use of the premises and recreational gear provided with the premises or others whom they invite to use the premise.

4. Keep the property and all furnishings in good order.

5. Only use appliances for their intended uses.

6. Bed linens and bath towels are included in the home. Please do not use rental houses linens at the beach. Beach towels are not provided in the home.

7. Please know we do not rent to student groups or to guests under the age of 25. Guest whose name is on the reservation must be present for the duration of the stay.

*DEPARTURE CHECKLIST:
• Empty refrigerator of all perishables. Remove all garbage from the home and take to exterior trash bins.
• Load any dirty dishes in the dishwasher and begin the wash cycle (use dishwasher detergent).
• Keep beds turned down that have been slept in.
• Place any used towels in the laundry room.
• Turn off all lights and ceiling fans, turn thermostat to 65°F in colder seasons and 74°F in warmer seasons.
• Close & lock all windows and exterior doors. Return key to lockbox.
• Check out on time, no later than 10am CT firm. If you’re leaving prior to 10am CT please text 30A Sea Story at the number listed on your arrival details so the cleaning crew can enter the home. THANK YOU!
*Homes left in complete disarray will be subject to an additional cleaning fee. Listing sites will be provided with photographs.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
